ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Our political decisions are determined by how the options are framed, and this mechanism can make a mockery of the feeling that our democratic choices proceed by ordering our desires or preferences. Political conversation evokes a range of loosely connected attitudes. In three successive years, researchers from the General Social Survey asked whether we were spending "too much, too little, or about the right amount" on a variety of government programs. In each year, 20 to 25 percent of the respondents said that too little was being spent on "welfare," but 63 to 65 percent said that too little was being spent on "assistance to the poor." Once again, if our democratic choices were based on the ranking of preferences, our decisions wouldn't be affected differently by the terms "welfare" and "assistance to the poor." But these two concepts could certainly tap into different aspects of our attitudes toward this assistance. And we may resist these findings because they conflict with a story we hold dear about free will and choice — in this case, democratic choice.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ that → whether (asked의 목적절이 '~인지 아닌지'의 간접의문문이므로 whether가 필요)

✅ ① determined: 'are determined by ~'에서 수동태의 과거분사로 올바른 어법

✅ ④ spending: 'we were spending'에서 과거진행형의 현재분사로 올바른 어법

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① won't → wouldn't (가정법 과거 if절에 대응하는 주절은 would가 필요)
det.analysis:
❌ ② won't → wouldn't: 'if our democratic choices were based on ~, our decisions won't be affected'에서 if절이 가정법 과거(were)이므로 주절은 would + 동사원형이 와야 함 ←정답
✅ ① differently: 'be affected differently'에서 부사로 올바른 어법
✅ ③ certainly: 'could certainly tap into'에서 부사로 올바른 어법
✅ ④ dear: 'hold dear'에서 목적격 보어 형용사로 올바른 어법

det.korean: ④ dismiss(무시하다) → hold(간직하다)
det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① ordering our desires or preferences: 'proceed by ordering our desires or preferences'에서 민주적 선택이 욕구/선호를 정렬하여 진행된다는 원문에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② ranking of preferences: 뒤에서 가정법 조건절에 나오는 표현이지만 'proceed by ~' 뒤에는 동명사구가 와야 하며 문맥상 '진행되는 방식'이 아님

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문에 'In three successive years, researchers ~ asked ~ on a variety of government programs'라고 명시되어 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문에서 3년 연속(three successive years) 정부 프로그램 지출에 대해 조사한 것이 확인됨 ←정답
❌ ② 20~25%만이 welfare 지출이 부족하다고 했을 뿐, 절반 이상이 과다하다고 한 것이 아님
❌ ③ welfare(20~25%)와 assistance to the poor(63~65%)의 응답률이 크게 달랐음
❌ ④ '너무 많은지, 너무 적은지, 적정한지' 묻는 방식이었지 순위 매김이 아님
det.tip: 'In three successive years(3년 연속)'에서 successive는 '연이은, 연속적인'을 뜻합니다.

ch: 3년 연속 진행된 설문에서 정부 프로그램 지출에 대한 의견을 조사했다
응답자의 절반 이상이 복지 분야 지출이 과다하다고 응답했다
복지와 빈곤층 지원이라는 용어는 동일한 응답 결과를 이끌어냈다
연구자들은 응답자의 선호도를 순위로 매기는 방식을 사용했다

questions.passage: Our political decisions are determined by how the options are framed, and this mechanism can make a mockery of the feeling that our democratic choices proceed by ordering our desires or preferences. Political conversation evokes a range of loosely connected attitudes. In three successive years, researchers from the General Social Survey asked whether we were spending "too much, too little, or about the right amount" on a variety of government programs. In each year, 20 to 25 percent of the respondents said that too little was being spent on "welfare," but 63 to 65 percent said that too little was being spent on "assistance to the poor." Once again, if our democratic choices were based on the ranking of preferences, our decisions wouldn't be affected differently by the terms "welfare" and "assistance to the poor." But these two concepts could certainly tap into different aspects of our attitudes toward this assistance. And we may resist these findings because they conflict with a story we hold dear about free will and choice — in this case, democratic choice.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문에 따르면 이 연구 결과는 자유의지에 대한 믿음과 '충돌(conflict)'하여 사람들이 '저항(resist)'하는 것이지, 부합하여 받아들여지는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'Our political decisions are determined by how the options are framed'과 일치

❌ ③ 본문은 'resist these findings because they conflict with ~'로, 부합하여 받아들여진다는 것은 정반대 ←정답
✅ ④ '63 to 65 percent said that too little was being spent on assistance to the poor'와 일치
det.tip: 'resist these findings because they conflict with ~'에서 resist(저항하다)와 conflict(충돌하다)는 받아들이기 어려워하는 심리를 나타냅니다.
